notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.content: [p]Version v1.3.0 Patch Notes:[/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/p][p]* Removed the ability for AI to be aggroed at a long distance by looking at them while under max terror[/p][p]* The "Another Night Passes" achievement will now be rewarded even if the night finishes with achieving the "The End" achievement[/p][p]* Reduced how long it takes for the first AI of the night to show up[/p]

tags.bug: - Removed the ability for AI to be aggroed at a long distance by looking at them while under max terror
- The "Another Night Passes" achievement will now be rewarded even if the night finishes with achieving the "The End" achievement

tags.balance_change: - Reduced how long it takes for the first AI of the night to show up

notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.content: [p]Version v1.2.0 Patch Notes:[/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/p][p] * Improved collision around a few areas where it was possible to get stuck while jumping between broken walls[/p][p] * Fixed some asset clipping issues in a few of the bunker's rooms[/p][p] * Small adjustments to puzzle hints in notes[/p]

tags.bug: * Improved collision around a few areas where it was possible to get stuck while jumping between broken walls
* Fixed some asset clipping issues in a few of the bunker's rooms

tags.balance_change: * Small adjustments to puzzle hints in notes

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content: [p]Version v1.1.0 Patch Notes:[/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/p][p]* Changed the default FPS cap to 60 (down from 144. This can be changed in the settings menu to 30, 60, 120, 144, 240, or unlimited if desired)[/p][p]* Made it more clear that shaders are precompiled while in the main menu. Shader pre-compilation helps reduce and prevent in-game stutters when new effects are played. This can optionally be disabled in the settings menu[/p][p]* Moved the note that indicates where the maintenance key is to a more noticeable spot[/p]

tags.balance_change: * Changed the default FPS cap to 60 (down from 144. This can be changed in the settings menu to 30, 60, 120, 144, 240, or unlimited if desired)

tags.feature: * Made it more clear that shaders are precompiled while in the main menu. Shader pre-compilation helps reduce and prevent in-game stutters when new effects are played. This can optionally be disabled in the settings menu

tags.bug: * Moved the note that indicates where the maintenance key is to a more noticeable spot
